definitions.explanation: The art of dancing, especially traditional or artistic dance forms.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{舞踊|ぶよう}を{学|まな}ぶ。
{舞踊|ぶよう}の{公演|こうえん}を{見|み}た。
{舞踊家|ぶようか}として{活躍|かつやく}している。

notes:
{舞踊|ぶよう} is a formal, artistic term for dance, encompassing both Japanese traditional dance and Western dance forms.

COMPONENTS:
{舞|ぶ} (classical dance, twirling) + {踊|よう} (lively dance, jumping). Together they cover the full range of dance as art.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本|にほん}{舞踊|ぶよう}: Japanese traditional dance
- {舞踊|ぶよう}{公演|こうえん}: dance performance
- {舞踊家|ぶようか}: dancer (professional)
- {創作|そうさく}{舞踊|ぶよう}: creative/contemporary dance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ダンス: dance (loanword, everyday, modern dance styles)
- {踊|おど}り: dance (general, everyday)
- バレエ: ballet
- {舞|まい}: classical Japanese dance (more specific, traditional)
